author: Inside Edition
description: It's hard to believe, but Eva Pilgrim just celebrated her first anniversary hosting Inside Edition! Since there's no better way to celebrate than with delicious food, Eva visited New York's Sur La Table, where she got to indulge both her Southern and her Korean roots by making barbecue with a host of friends. Congratulations, Eva!
title: Eva Pilgrim Deliciously Celebrates Her First Anniversary At Inside Edition

author: Inside Edition
description: It may be one of the wildest Uber rides ever. Two Houston, Texas police officers chasing a suspect on foot jumped into an Uber, enlisting the driver's help in the pursuit. The ride lasted about two minutes, and the officers were unable to locate the suspect. The unusual incident was captured on a surveillance camera inside the car. Now, Inside Edition's Jim Moret is talking with that Uber driver about the night he'll never forget.
title: Cops Use Uber To Pursue Suspect

author: Inside Edition
description: Hayden Panetierre's estranged mother lashed out in her first sit-down interview since her daughter's death. Lesley Vogel appeared on "Good Morning America," where she said that despite her daughter's incredible talent, Hayden couldn't overcome her demons. Panetierre died earlier this month in Greenville, South Carolina. The "Heroes" and "Nashville" star would have turned 37 this past week. Inside Edition's Steven Fabian reports.
title: Hayden Panetierre's Mother Lashes Out In Interview

author: Inside Edition
description: The Lindsay Clancy trial continues to fascinate and divide the nation. One side thinks she should do time for killing her three children, while others think she didn't get the help she needed for postpartum psychosis. Lindsay's ex-husband Patrick Clancy is caught in the crossfire, with some armchair detectives wrongly blaming him for what happened. But others are coming to his defense, as Inside Edition's Ann Mercogliano reports.
title: Why Has The Lindsay Clancy Trial Divided The Nation?

author: Inside Edition
description: Terms like clutch and shift aren't used a lot by driving instructors these days, but some students want to get to know them. In fact, longtime drivers are going back to school to learn the ancient art of driving a stick shift. Ferrari Driving School in New York tells CBS News their manual Volkswagen is very much in commission. They say about 30 to 40 students request lessons in manual transmission driving every month. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Drivers Are Going Back to School To Learn How To Operate Stick Shift Cars

author: Inside Edition
description: Helga de Kansky is a lifelong ballerina, and her life has been quite long thus far. She tells KCBS she was trained in New York and performed all around the world, but stopped touring to get married and start a family. While she may have hung up her dancing shoes, de Kansky's love of ballet never went away. That's how she ended up teaching ballet to dancers of all levels in Pasadena, California. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 99-Year-Old Ballet Teacher Says She Will Never Stop Dancing

author: Inside Edition
description: This snake is a star at her zoo! Not only does she share a name with famous actress, Jodie Foster, she was also cured of cancer using treatments reserved for people. Her caretakers at the Chester Zoo in England believe she is the first snake to receive electrochemotherapy. At 23 years old, Jodie could now live out the remaining seven years or so left on a python's lifespan. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Python May Be First Of Its Kind To Be Cured Of Cancer With Electrochemotherapy

author: Inside Edition
description: We've all been there before. Upset after someone interrupts our sleep. Which is what happened when a kitten was rescued from a barrier on a New York highway. John Debacker from Long Island Cat Kitten Solution was called when a kitten was spotted getting some beauty rest on the divider in the middle of Sunrise Highway by exit 46. Cats are known for being unbothered, but a kitten asleep in the middle of traffic is on a whole other level. Inside Edition Digital's Andrea Swindall has more.
title: Kitten Upset After It's Rescued While Asleep On Freeway Divider
